title: Actual Quiz 3
notes: The Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP) is NP-hard; no polynomial algorithm is known.
The Assignment Problem is polynomial-time solvable using the Hungarian Algorithm.
Polynomial evaluation p(x) can be done in linear time using Horner’s Rule.
Exhaustive search tries all possibilities to guarantee a solution.
Depth-First Search (DFS) explores as deep as possible before backtracking.
Breadth-First Search (BFS) explores level by level.
DFS uses a stack (explicit or call stack); BFS uses a queue.
DFS and BFS both operate on graphs and trees.

flashcards.back: No, linear-time solvable via Horner’s Rule.
